title: New Battle Royale Brawler Web Game
author: Hot_Kaleidoscope4892
selftext:
Hi All,

  
I have been making a battle-royale, brawler based shooter game designed for quick matches and to be played in browser. It has unlockable fighters, who all have 3 unique attacks and varying speed, size and fire rate. This allows for varied matches and tight match-ups, while allowing for lots of different playstyles!

I have been using Claude Code to help develop my game, specifically with the multiplayer that is currently in the pipeline. It has been incredibly useful at creating the game!

I would love some feedback on the game, you can try it out here at:

[cycloid.cc](http://cycloid.cc)

Thanks!
